name: Steve Roberts

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single large primary residence with a dark roof and irregular building footprint|A long paved driveway provides access from the street and curves toward the front of the house|A large rectangular swimming pool is visible behind the main structure|The lot includes landscaped areas, mature trees, and open lawn space surrounding the residence.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence features a covered entry area with multiple windows visible along the façade|A wide paved driveway leads to the front of the house with space for vehicle parking and turnaround|Mature trees and landscaping are present along both sides of the driveway and near the front of the structure.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows mature tree coverage and landscaping immediately adjacent to the building|A portion of the swimming pool and surrounding hardscape is visible|Limited building openings appear on this elevation.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence includes a large rectangular swimming pool with surrounding patio and hardscape areas|Mature trees and vegetation border the rear of the property|A paved area is visible adjacent to the pool.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side elevation with multiple windows and a sloped roofline|Mature trees and landscaping run along this side of the property|A portion of the driveway and open lawn area is visible.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a long paved driveway that curves from the street toward the front of the house and provides space for vehicle turnaround. The swimming pool and surrounding hardscape at the rear offer potential open areas for movement. Dense mature trees and landscaping along multiple sides of the building may limit visibility and create potential obstructions for movement around the structure. The rear of the property appears accessible via the pool area and surrounding hardscape.
